name: foam-rolling-anterior-calf
instructions:
1. In a prone position, pull one leg into hip flexion and place the foam roller directly underneath the front of your calf between your knee and foot. Avoid the bony portion of your shin and shift a bit laterally to the muscular portion (tibialis anterior) of your calf.
2. Support your upper body using your hands and foot. Position your other leg behind the body in hip extension.
3. Adjust pressure into the roller by applying more or less force through the hands and foot.
4. Slowly roll up and down the length of the quadriceps while slightly rotating the leg periodically for 20-30 seconds.
5. Repeat on the other side.
